title: Bring Down & Bring Out
situation: Moving boxes and taking test equipment out for a check.
objective: Use bring down and bring out to talk about moving things to another place.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Before the check, I bring down the tool box from the top shelf.
dialogue.indonesian: Sebelum pemeriksaan, saya menurunkan kotak alat dari rak paling atas.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: When the box is heavy, I ask a teammate for help.
dialogue.indonesian: Jika kotaknya berat, saya meminta bantuan rekan kerja.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: After the repair, we bring out the test bag from the room.
dialogue.indonesian: Setelah perbaikan, kami mengeluarkan tas uji dari ruangan.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: We bring out the old cable and put it in the correct box.
dialogue.indonesian: Kami mengeluarkan kabel lama dan menaruhnya di kotak yang benar.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Please bring down the small box from the shelf when you finish.
dialogue.indonesian: Tolong turunkan kotak kecil dari rak setelah selesai.

learningNotes: bring down berarti membawa sesuatu dari tempat yang lebih tinggi ke tempat yang lebih rendah.
bring out berarti membawa sesuatu keluar.
Pronoun diletakkan di tengah: bring it down, bring it out.
